_comment: Of the poles, and the first word written to read by where it is laid rather than to have a variant per
place (the readings spike, 2026-09-29). Laid bare it only nudges: a polar Age leans cold, grows the
frozen biomes and seas more often, may be offered an aurora, snow in the air and brighter stars, and
bends the temperature toward the cold end without pinning it.
Aimed, it claims, and attachment decides which claim lands: `polar climate` the cold temperature,
`polar sun` and `polar moon` the polar path -- a circle held just over the horizon, never setting,
which is the paper tree's window (design 7.1.2) and holds a tide at one level under a moon.
